about: What the game simulation (server/simulationTests.js) left behind after each step. Recorded from the code before the Meteor upgrade; see that file before recording it again.

steps.step: four players sign up and the game starts
everyone trades at the market and hires soldiers
alice marches on bob and carol on dave
alice sends her vassal gold, and bob builds a village and upgrades it
carol splits her army and sends half home, alice's first army goes home
alice takes carol's castle and becomes dominus
invariantProblems: num_allies_above counts the list: sim_dave has 1, the list has 2

the game closes three days after that
